hints.title: Partition Boundaries
hints.text: Dividing the sorted values separates numbers into a smaller partition and a larger partition.

hints.title: Adjacent Gap Minimization
hints.text: The minimum partition difference equals the minimum difference between any two adjacent elements in sorted order.

hints.title: Single Pass Comparison
hints.text: Sort the array and inspect adjacent differences.

hints.title: Sorted Difference Code

complexity.notes: Sorting brings closest numeric values together.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all 2^n partitions is impossible; sorting isolates the closest pair directly.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: In-place sort takes O(1) extra space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes that the optimal partition splits at the minimum adjacent gap in sorted order.
